biomarkers.name: SSTR2 (somatostatin receptor 2)
biomarkers.prevalence: Commonly positive in well-differentiated GI NETs, especially low-grade tumours
biomarkers.clinical_use: DOTATATE PET for staging in SSTR-positive disease. Somatostatin analogues (octreotide, lanreotide — PROMID, CLARINET). PRRT (177Lu-DOTATATE — NETTER-1)

biomarkers.name: Chromogranin A
biomarkers.prevalence: Often elevated, but variable and non-specific
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adjunctive disease monitoring; false positives with PPIs, renal impairment, atrophic gastritis

biomarkers.name: 5-HIAA (24-hour urine)
biomarkers.prevalence: Elevated in serotonin-producing functional midgut NETs/carcinoid syndrome
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnosis and monitoring of carcinoid syndrome (midgut NETs)

biomarkers.name: MEN1 (germline)
biomarkers.prevalence: Uncommon in GI NETs overall; most relevant in duodenal/gastric/pancreatic NET predisposition rather than typical small-bowel midgut NETs
biomarkers.clinical_use: Genetic counselling if syndromic features, multifocal disease, young age, or family history; classically associated with pancreatic/duodenal NETs, pituitary, parathyroid

biomarkers.name: CDKN1B
biomarkers.prevalence: Recurrent but infrequent; reported in a minority of small bowel NETs
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic recurrent somatic alteration described in small bowel (midgut) well-differentiated NETs; not currently a routine predictive biomarker

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Organoid (nested, trabecular) growth of monomorphic cells with 'salt and pepper' chromatin
variants: goblet cell adenocarcinoma (mixed lineage — treated as adenocarcinoma)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Ki-67 <3% and mitoses <2/2 mm² by definition (G1)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Gastrointestinal enterochromaffin cells (EC cells) and enterochromaffin-like cells (ECL) of diffuse neuroendocrine system
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — GI tract; enterochromaffin cells arise from endodermal progenitors, not neural crest
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Well-differentiated neuroendocrine — synaptophysin+, chromogranin+, often high SSTR2 expression, Ki-67 <3%
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Position on well-differentiated end of GI NET spectrum; distinct site-specific hormone production (gastrin for gastric ECL-associated lesions, serotonin for midgut EC; hindgut NETs are often less functional)
